items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s good to know. I didn’t know I played with Bill Evans.

ctx.x: Bill’s trio then was with Eddie Gomez and Marty Morrell.
That’s good to know. I didn’t know I played with Bill Evans.
Maybe you did. Maybe you played on – like you said, “I don’t remember recording with Mingus,” but you have – maybe not, but it was his date.
